label: The women buy spices, find the tomb open, and flee in fear
statement: After the Sabbath Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Salome bought spices to anoint him; very early on the first day of the week, at sunrise, they found the great stone rolled back and a young man in a white robe inside who told them 'He has risen; he is not here' and to tell his disciples and Peter that he goes before them into Galilee; they fled from the tomb and said nothing to anyone, for they were afraid.

label: Appearances of the risen Jesus (longer ending)
statement: The risen Jesus appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom he had cast out seven demons, then in another form to two of them walking into the country, then to the eleven at table; those who heard did not believe.

label: The commission and the signs of believers (longer ending)
statement: The risen Jesus commissioned the eleven to go into all the world and preach the gospel to the whole creation, saying that he who believes and is baptized will be saved, and that signs will accompany believers: casting out demons, speaking new languages, taking up serpents, drinking deadly things unharmed, and healing the sick by the laying on of hands.

label: The ascension and the preaching everywhere (longer ending)
statement: The Lord, after speaking to them, was received up into heaven and sat down at the right hand of God; and the disciples went out and preached everywhere.

title: Mark 16

label: Wikipedia: Mark 16 (patristic attestation)
title: Mark 16
excerpt: Irenaeus (c. 184), in Against Heresies 3:10.6, explicitly cited Mark 16:19, stating that he was quoting from near the end of Mark's account. This patristic evidence is over a century older than the earliest manuscript of Mark 16.
